newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices sag, Brazil offers July/Aug.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices sag, Brazil offers July/Aug.

text.p: Bremen cash arabica prices eased by $2-16 on the week per 50 kg fob in line with futures in a market dominated by Brazilian July/August offers, traders said on Friday.
Futures eased on beneficial Brazilian crop weather.
Importers reported some interest in nearby robustas, where Indonesian cif prices remained steady at $84.
Colombia made some price concessions and Central American sellers invited bids for shipment beyond October, they added.
Kenyan prices eased from their previous highs but remained at historically high levels.
